Description
Wall Center is home to a highly sought after residence. The unique '08' corner suite is difficult to find and offers stunning views in the south, east, and north directions. The suite features two bedrooms and two bathrooms, air conditioning, and a renovated interior with a quartz kitchen countertop, dining room, and stainless steel appliances. The master bedroom and second bedroom both have ample closet space, and the suite includes a balcony with room for a BBQ and seating area. The residence comes with one parking spot and one storage locker. The Wall Center is located in the heart of Vancouver, making it easy for residents to access all that the city has to offer. The building is just a short walk from popular shopping destinations such as Pacific Centre and Robson Street. Furnished!
